# Student Advisor

> Student Advisor provides free, practical guidance for prospective international students exploring UK university study, applications and supporting documents.

## About

Student Advisor helps students compare suitable UK study options, understand admissions preparation and plan their next steps. Guidance is provided by advisers and is free for students.

## Public guides

- [Free Student Advisory](https://student-advisor.co.uk/free-student-advisory): How the free advisory journey works, from profile assessment to document preparation and university shortlisting.
- [Study in the UK](https://student-advisor.co.uk/study-in-uk): A guide to UK study planning, degree routes, costs, English-language tests and application planning.
- [University Admission](https://student-advisor.co.uk/university-admission): A guide to university applications, admissions documents and planning deadlines.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://student-advisor.co.uk/terms): The terms for using Student Advisor services and the application platform.

## Contact and applications

Students can create an account and submit an enquiry through the Student Advisor website. Student accounts, Advisor workspaces and Admin workspaces are private and are not public reference material.
